portal.vendor_source: portal fingerprint: Idox advanced search page (search.do, JSESSIONID on /online-applications, hidden _csrf, Idox markup) re-checked on 2026-09-29. Documents are on a separate NEC PublicAccess host.

document_host.note: The Idox documents tab returns HTTP 200 with 'Permission Denied'; the detail page's externalDocuments tab links out here. List: GET /PublicAccess_LIVE/SearchResult/RunThirdPartySearch?FileSystemId=DP&FOLDER1_REF=<REF> (the reference raw, slashes unencoded), whose HTML embeds a JSON model with Rows[] of Guid, Doc_Type, Doc_Ref2, Date_Received. Download: GET /PublicAccess_LIVE/Document/ViewDocument?id=<Guid>. Constructible from the reference; no Idox session needed.

committee_papers.note: Linked from the Idox portal's footer. Committee id confirmed by the Modern.gov web service (GetCommittees) on 2026-09-29; 309 is Planning Committee Visits. No committee document downloaded.

reference_format.note: YY/NNNNN/TYPE. Passed raw, with slashes, as FOLDER1_REF on the document host.

quirks.summary: WAF signals present (cloudflare) but the landing page served normally.
quirks.detail: Passive at survey time. Not a reason to avoid the automated route; it is a reason to pace properly and to expect a challenge if you do not.

quirks.summary: The Idox documents tab returns HTTP 200 with 'Permission Denied' and no files; the documents are on an NEC PublicAccess host.
quirks.detail: See portal.document_host. Four applications in a row showed the same Permission Denied tab. The detail page's externalDocuments tab carries the link.
quirks.workaround: Go to RunThirdPartySearch?FileSystemId=DP&FOLDER1_REF=<REF> on necdm.doncaster.gov.uk, then ViewDocument?id=<Guid>.

quirks.summary: Search-result metadata is separated by '|', not the U+00B7 middle dot seen on other Idox installs.
quirks.detail: All 36 <span class="divider"> elements on a results page held '|'.
quirks.workaround: Take the reference from 'Ref. No:' up to the first divider span, whichever character it holds.

quirks.summary: The document host's Date_Received values are US-ordered (MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm:ss).
quirks.workaround: Parse as month/day/year when labelling files.

robots.note: planning.doncaster.gov.uk/robots.txt is 'User-agent: *' with 'Disallow: /'. necdm.doncaster.gov.uk has no robots.txt (404).

endpoints.note: The Idox portal is needed only to find the reference; the document host is keyed by the reference itself.

browser_route.note: The document list for one application, built from the reference.

pacing.note: Ten requests to the Idox host and three to the document host at 5-6 s spacing on 2026-09-29, no 429 or challenge. Both hosts are behind Cloudflare, passive throughout.

verification.note: Landing-page survey 2026-09-16: HTTP 200; vendor confirmed by fingerprint (idox-public-access); WAF signals: cloudflare
Search worked over 1-31 July 2026; documents tab had no file links.

Vendor fingerprinted from markup as Idox. robots.txt fetched on both hosts. Advanced search by received date 14-18 September 2026 -> 10 keyVals (13-character form). The documents tab for four applications returned 200 with 'Permission Denied' and no file links; the summary page's externalDocuments tab linked https://necdm.doncaster.gov.uk/PublicAccess_LIVE/SearchResult/RunThirdPartySearch?FileSystemId=DP&FOLDER1_REF=26/01778/TPO. That list held 4 rows. Downloaded the tree site plan via ViewDocument?id=<Guid>: application/pdf, %PDF-1.7, 3,583,720 bytes, 1 page with extractable text, no rate-limit, permission or unavailable notice. Dropped quirks: 'search-confirmed-documents-untested' (documents now verified) and 'documents-tab-empty' (explained: the documents are on the external host). Kept 'waf-present': both hosts answered with Server: cloudflare and no challenge. Modern.gov GetCommittees checked for the committee ids.
